fields.description: Task, the gate's own records (its settings, this table, AI Pending Action, AI Action Log) and the knowledge base (Knowledge Article, Knowledge Article Version) are never exempt; a row for one is ignored.
Leave empty for a permanent exemption. Set a time to open a window for a bulk job: the exemption stops at that moment by itself, and the row can be deleted afterwards.
